metadata.title: Prospective, model-conditional cosmology forecasts (12 November 2026) — REV3
metadata.description: REV3 of dated, model-conditional cosmology forecasts by C.A.S.D.R. REV3 supersedes all BAO + compressed-CMB rows of REV1/REV2 after calibration of the compressed Planck 2018 CMB prior (l_A control at the Planck mean now 301.4707; prior-only flat-ΛCDM fit H0 67.28, Ωm h² 0.1432). BAO-only rows are unchanged. Euclid DR1-Foundation (12 November 2026) only timestamps these forecasts; the strongest tests need DR1 Complete (mid-2027). No statistical-test claims are made.
